brief:
Israeli forces carried out demolition operations in southern Lebanon on Saturday, destroying a school and setting houses ablaze across multiple areas in the Nabatiyeh, Tyre, and Marjayoun districts, Shehab Wire reported. The operations included airstrikes, artillery bombardment, and controlled demolitions targeting residential areas.

The strikes hit villages across three southern governorates, affecting civilian infrastructure and housing in what marked an intensification of military activity in the border region.

title: Israeli military demolishes school, shells homes in south Lebanon
